Now let me get full details on the source creation, aggregation, and status operations in parallel.
Let me find the source creation operation directly.

Here's the full end-to-end walkthrough. All requests go to `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`.

---

## Step 1 — Get a Bearer Token

Exchange a PAT (Personal Access Token) for an access token via client credentials. Keep client credentials **in the request body, never the query string**.

```http
POST /oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID
&client_secret=YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET
```

Save the returned `access_token`. All subsequent calls need:
```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

---

## Step 2 — Create the Source

`POST /v3/sources`  
Required scope: `idn:sources:manage`  
Required body fields: `name`, `owner`, `connector`

```http
POST /v3/sources
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "My LDAP Source",
  "description": "Corporate directory",
  "owner": {
    "type": "IDENTITY",
    "id": "<owner-identity-id>",
    "name": "Jane Admin"
  },
  "connector": "active-directory",
  "connectorAttributes": {
    "host": "ldap.example.com",
    "port": 389,
    "baseDN": "DC=example,DC=com"
  },
  "authoritative": false,
  "deleteThreshold": 10
}
```

> Use `connector: "delimited-file"` and add `?provisionAsCsv=true` to the URL if you're setting up a flat-file/CSV source — don't set the `type` field directly for that case.

The response body will contain the new source's `id`. Save it — you'll need it as `{sourceId}` in the next step.

---

## Step 3 — Kick Off Account Aggregation

`POST /beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts`  
Required scope: `idn:sources:manage`  
**Beta endpoint — must include `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`**

```http
POST /beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
X-SailPoint-Experimental: true
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

disableOptimization=false
```

- `disableOptimization=false` (default): ISC uses delta detection to only process changed accounts — faster for incremental runs.
- `disableOptimization=true`: forces a full re-evaluation of every account.
- `file`: optional. Attach a CSV file here if you're doing a file-based aggregation instead of a live connector pull.

The response will include the aggregation job `id`. Save it.

---

## Step 4 — Poll Aggregation Status

`GET /beta/account-aggregations/{id}/status`  
**Beta endpoint — must include `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`**

```http
GET /beta/account-aggregations/{id}/status
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
X-SailPoint-Experimental: true
```

The response shows progress in real time:

```json
{
  "id": "<aggregation-id>",
  "status": "STARTED",
  "totalAccounts": 1500,
  "processedAccounts": 842,
  "newAccounts": 12,
  "changedAccounts": 4,
  "deletedAccounts": 1
}
```

Poll until `status` transitions out of `STARTED`. Terminal states are `COMPLETE` and `FAILED`.

---

## Quick reference

| # | Call | Version | Experimental header |
|---|------|---------|---------------------|
| 1 | `POST /oauth/token` | oauth | No |
| 2 | `POST /v3/sources` | v3 | No |
| 3 | `POST /beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts` | beta | **Yes** |
| 4 | `GET /beta/account-aggregations/{id}/status` | beta | **Yes** |

**Required scope for steps 2 & 3:** `idn:sources:manage`
